svg.title: Space-Based
svg.desc: Space-Based. Processing units share an in-memory data grid, taking the database off the hot path. Step 1, Database bottleneck: Every seat check is a database query, so adding app servers only pushes the database to 100%. Step 2, In-memory units: Units load the seats into memory and answer from it; the data grid copies A-12 to unit 2. Step 3, Asynchronous writes: Each change also goes onto a data pump; a data writer updates the database in the background. Step 4, Elastic, with trade-offs: The deployment manager runs 2 to 8 units. Units 1 and 2 both sold B-7: a data collision.

g.text: Every seat check is a database query, so adding app servers only pushes the database to 100%.
Units load the seats into memory and answer from it; the data grid copies A-12 to unit 2.
Each change also goes onto a data pump; a data writer updates the database in the background.
The deployment manager runs 2 to 8 units. Units 1 and 2 both sold B-7: a data collision.
